rng: Python random.Random, separate per-pair streams using string seed <seed>:<profile|global|block>
weights: Per target independently draw degree uniformly from 1..4, then each weight uniformly from 1..4. Both arms share the ordered vector.
wiring: Four equal contiguous groups. Global sources uniform among all eligible nonself sources. Block arm first chooses within-group source with probability .8 and outside-group otherwise. Sources used at most once per target.
methods: Locked protocol versus per-graph minimum of row-tight and marginal intervals, ranked by peak E, total D+H, then D.
endpoints: Aggregate peak saving 1-sum(E_locked)/sum(E_strong) separately by arm; peak wins/ties/losses, mean completion-time change, pooled E*D and relative change. Paired contrast of absolute unit savings ((E_strong-E_locked)_block minus same for global) and arm savings percentages.
validation: Verify unique matrix hashes, diagonal zero, equal per-target incoming weight multisets and equal row baselines in each pair, all plans within budget; reference-replay two initial states of each graph under the locked plan. Pooled within-group edge fraction reported separately by arm. Descriptive fixed panel; no causal claims for community membership independently of outgoing degrees.
